summary:
A gunman opened fire in Krakow’s main market square on Saturday, killing six people, Polish authorities said. Reported numbers of wounded differ, at 15, 16 and 17. Police shot the gunman, who was taken to hospital, and three more bodies, those of his parents and sister, were found at his home. Poland’s defence minister called the attack an “act of terror”, and a minister said the suspect held “ultra-nationalistic” views. Poland began two days of mourning.

Israel’s president on Saturday chose Gadi Eisenkot, a former military chief and Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s strongest rival, to try to form a new government. Eisenkot has declined to join forces with Arab parties, whose support would give him a majority of seats in parliament.

New Zealand’s election is too close to call. National will be the largest party in parliament, but fewer than 4,000 votes separate the two main parties after over 95% of votes were counted. Official results are not expected until later this month, once special votes have been counted.

headlines.title: Gunman kills six in Krakow market square shooting
headlines.summary: A gunman opened fire in Krakow's main market square on Saturday, killing six people and wounding others. Police shot the gunman, and three more bodies, those of his parents and sister, were found at his home.

headlines.title: Israeli president asks Gadi Eisenkot to form government
headlines.summary: Israel's president chose Gadi Eisenkot, a former military chief, to try to form a government after an inconclusive election. He has declined to join forces with Arab parties, whose support would give him a majority in parliament.

headlines.title: New Zealand election too close to call with weeks of uncertainty
headlines.summary: New Zealand's election is too close to call, with fewer than 4,000 votes separating the two main parties after over 95% of votes were counted. Official results are not expected until later this month, once special votes are counted.

headlines.title: Republicans lose majority in both US congressional chambers
headlines.summary: Republicans lost their majority in both chambers of Congress in the US midterm elections, and Democrats are set to take over Congress in January. President Trump still holds considerable power, and Democrats have yet to agree on how to use theirs.

headlines.title: US launches task force to disrupt land routes into Iran
headlines.summary: The US has launched a task force to disrupt land transit routes into Iran, to stop Iran moving weapons and other materials by ground, the US says. The move expands a US naval blockade of Iranian ports during the two countries’ eight-month war.

headlines.title: Magnitude 5.7 earthquake injures at least 22 in central Japan
headlines.summary: A magnitude 5.7 earthquake struck Shizuoka Prefecture at 1:04 a.m., injuring at least 22 people and shattering store windows. Authorities warned of possible strong aftershocks in the next two to three days.

headlines.title: Heavy rain floods tents of displaced Palestinians in Gaza
headlines.summary: Heavy rain has flooded thousands of tents sheltering displaced Palestinians across Gaza, including in Deir al-Balah, with residents saying sewage has mixed with the floodwater. Local authorities say tens of thousands have been left without shelter, and Israeli restrictions on aid are hampering the response.
